name: XAUUSD_D1_MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT

entry_rules.momentum_condition: body_pct_threshold >= 0.95 (top 5% momentum bars by body return)
entry_rules.description: Enter LONG on next D1 bar open when: (1) D1 EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish trend), (2) D1 body return is in top 5% of recent 60-day range (strong up-momentum), (3) D1 ATR14/mean(close) >= 0.5% (active volatility).

stop.description: Stop = entry - 1.5x D1-ATR(14). Stop distance is typically 200-350 pips on D1 gold, which is wide but appropriate for multi-day holding.

description: D1 momentum breakout strategy: rides the confirmed D1 long bias using top-momentum daily bars as entry trigger. Unlike V1-V10 (M5/M15 scalping which had no edge due to 0.11% cost floor), D1 has sufficient price movement to overcome costs (~0.013% round-trip on H1, proportionally small on D1). The strategy captures multi-day trending moves. STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT from all prior versions.
hypothesis: XAUUSD has a persistent D1 long bias (54.1% up days over 10 years). Strong momentum days (top 5% body) on bullish D1 trend contexts produce multi-day continuation moves with positive expectancy after costs, because D1 price ranges (~200-400 pips over 8 bars) massively exceed the cost base.

walk_forward.note: OOS_mean EXCEEDS IS_mean (degeneration negative) — strong out-of-sample confirmation, not overfitting

parameter_sensitivity.body_pct_threshold: All values 0.80-0.98 produce positive net (37159-17994 pips, PF 1.36-2.46) — ROBUST REGION
parameter_sensitivity.rr: All values 1.5-4.0 produce positive net (9868-20132 pips, PF 1.50-2.20) — ROBUST REGION
parameter_sensitivity.atr_mult_stop: Values 0.5-2.0 all positive (3367-17994 pips, PF 1.12-2.10) — mostly robust
parameter_sensitivity.max_holding_d1: All values 1-21d produce positive net (5450-23023 pips, PF 1.45-2.35) — ROBUST REGION

research_results.conclusion: FIRST EDGE FOUND on XAUUSD. The D1 momentum breakout strategy survives all validation gates: IS positive + PF>1.5, OOS positive (IS_mean=3108, OOS_mean=7428 — DEGENERATION NEGATIVE meaning OOS exceeds IS), Monte Carlo robust (net_p5=12154>0, ruin_prob=0%, is_robust=True), broad parameter sensitivity (all nearby params positive). 82 trades over 10 years is low-frequency but the daily TF context justifies it. REQUIRES PAPER TRADING before any further consideration.

notes: Research script: research/v11_d1_momentum.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (D1 XAUUSD 10-year history, H1 10-year, M15 2-year). Cost model: round-trip ~0.013% on D1 (2x spread ~2.6 pips). The key breakthrough was extending data to D1 (10yr) and H1 (10yr) via MT5 history — M5/M15 2-year data was in a no-edge regime because the cost floor swallowed all drift, but D1's larger range makes the same bias tradable.
